name: runs_write

ops.description: Write operations, one flat object per op, run in order. A field marked [ops: ...] applies only to the ops named.

rootId.description: Project root of the run: a UUID or a hex prefix of 8 to 32 characters. [ops: open]

items.description: Ids of the member items (UUID or hex prefix), at most 500. [ops: open]

scopeId.description: Optional item whose subtree bounds the run (a UUID or a hex prefix). [ops: open]

label.description: Short display label, at most 64 characters. [ops: open]

title.description: Display title, at most 200 characters. [ops: open]

budget.description: Caps at or below the config ceilings: tokens, costUsd, attemptsPerSeat, maxActiveSeats. Absent means no cap; update may only lower. [ops: open, update]

stallAfterSeconds.description: Seconds without a heartbeat before a seat or the coordinator shows as stalled; default from config. [ops: open]

hints.description: Free-form routing hints (for example model), stored and echoed, never enforced. [ops: open, update, assign]

runId.description: Run id: a UUID or a hex prefix of 8 to 32 characters. [ops: update, close, assign, raise]

addItems.description: Item ids to add to the run. [ops: update]

removeItems.description: Item ids to remove from the run. [ops: update]

reason.description: Why the run ends; close ends active seats and releases member claims and leases. [ops: close]

summary.description: Closing summary, at most 500 characters. [ops: close, end_seat]

itemId.description: Item id: a UUID or a hex prefix of 8 to 32 characters. [ops: assign, raise]

seat.description: A seat of the item's schema (implementer or planner when it has none). Returns a seat token; re-assigning supersedes. [ops: assign]

outcome.description: How the calling seat ended. [ops: end_seat]

links.description: Up to 10 {kind, ref} pointers; kind is item, note, doc, commit or url. [ops: end_seat, raise]

class.description: Decision class (for example question or deviation); it decides who may answer. [ops: raise]

question.description: The question, at most 500 characters. [ops: raise]

options.description: 1 to 8 choices, each {key, label, consequence}. [ops: raise]

recommended.description: Key of the recommended option. [ops: raise]

context.description: Background for the answerer, at most 1000 characters. [ops: raise]

dedupeKey.description: Re-raising the same key returns the open or answered decision instead of a new one. [ops: raise]

block.description: true: also block itemId as awaiting_decision in the same unit. [ops: raise]

idempotencyKey.description: Optional client key (1-128 chars, needs actor). Resending the same op with the same key returns the stored result.

atomic.description: true: the first failing op rolls back the whole batch. Default false: each op commits on its own.

describe.description: true: return the operations, their parameters and errors instead of running the tool.

description: Write runs: open a run over items (returns runId and a coordinator token), update its members, budget or hints, close it, assign a seat to an item, end the calling seat, or raise a decision for a director or human. Call with describe:true for each operation's parameters and errors.
